notablePrerequisites: High Priest of Penance has indestructible.
easyPrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to High Priest of Penance.
description:
Deal damage to High Priest of Penance.
Howlpack Avenger and High Priest of Penance trigger.
Resolve the High Priest of Penance trigger, destroying a nonland permanent.
Resolve the Howlpack Avenger trigger, dealing that much damage to High Priest of Penance
Repeat from step 2.
